**Relay run log** — issue #89

- 2026-09-18 18:34Z — Relay picked up this issue for a BB worker run.
- 2026-09-18 20:47Z — Relay BB run pushed an update. Pull request: #438 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Branch pushed successfully. ## Summary Implements exactly-once execution for approved destructive operations (issue #89). `replayApprovedGenericOperation` in `packages/application/src/genericOperationGateway.ts` now runs the full revalidate-then-mutate protocol inside a single transaction that row-locks the approval request `FOR UPDATE`, short-circuits on already-terminal statuses, rejects rows that aren't `approved`+`queued`, revalidates actor provenance and resource authorization, executes the mutation, and marks it `succeeded` — with the outer error-swallowing `try/catch` removed so genuine failures propagate instead of being silently absorbed. `DestructiveApprovalPreflight` runs the same resource-authorization check a direct call would run before a pending approval request is ever created, which surfaced (and required fixing) an existing ownership check gap. Two previously-unchecked `UPDATE` statements (`genericOperationGateway.ts`, `packages/data/src/mcp/approvalRequestsStore.ts`) were wrapped with `requireAffectedRows`, and the write-safety baseline was updated for legitimate zero-rows-ok bulk operations. ## Test plan - [x] `pnpm run verify` in `backend/`: lint, format, build (17 packages), unit tests, migration/boundary checks, write-safety check, integration tests (112 files / 1440 tests), e2e tests (2 files / 9 tests) — all passing - [x] `web/`'s verify fails only on a pre-existing environment gap (`eslint`/`node_modules` missing) unrelated to this backend-only diff (confirmed zero changes under `web/`) Branch: `bb/relay-89-implementation-audit-fixes-19-23-execut-thr_jmggshs5vf` 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) Relay-Step-Status: pass
- 2026-09-18 23:35Z — Relay BB run pushed an update. Pull request: #438 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 Confirmed on GitHub: `refs/heads/bb/relay-89-implementation-audit-fixes-19-23-execut-thr_jmggshs5vf` at `4063006`. An initial push attempt was rejected as non-fast-forward: the remote already had a further commit (`4063006`, "Address PR #438 review findings on issue #89's exactly-once execution") addressing the same 12 review findings from a more thorough angle — a true additive expand-only migration for `execution_result` (a new `execution_result_jsonb` column, rather than my in-place-narrowing escape-hatch), the same single-writer store functions, the same false-success and idempotency fixes, plus genuine test coverage for the new behavior and a regenerated write-safety baseline. Rather than push a conflicting duplicate on top, I adopted that commit as the branch tip and re-verified it fully: lint, format, build, unit (410), pi-import-paths, migration numbering, write-safety, dependency-boundaries, integration (1442), and e2e (9) all pass. The branch is already at that verified commit on origin, so the push confirmed as up-to-date and no new commit was needed. Branch: `bb/relay-89-implementation-audit-fixes-19-23-execut-thr_jmggshs5vf` Relay-Step-Status: pass
